head: We were right.
We were
still wrong.
body: Our algorithm decided a driver had travelled 4km less than they thought. It was probably correct.
Shipping that silently would still have been wrong.

head: Show your
*working
slides.caption: The moment your output becomes somebody's reimbursement, correctness stops being enough. We were about to win the argument and lose the user.

items.title: The original
items.sub: what we measured before we touched it

items.title: The delta
items.sub: exactly what we removed, in their units

items.title: The reason
items.sub: in their language, not your enum name

items.title: The right to push back

head: Correctness is
table stakes.
*Transparency ships.
body: When your output becomes an input to somebody's money, time or reputation, the working IS the product.
Show the original, show the delta, show the reason, and let them argue.
